title: 🛠️ Tech Note: Fix for GPU Crash in Lumen in Unreal Engine 5.5
description: A GPU crash  issue has been identified in Unreal Engine 5.5 affecting projects using Lumen and primarily on Intel hardware. The problem stems from a group barrier inside a divergent branch in ScreenProbeConvertToIrradianceCS.  CL#42412951 (215041) is available to fix the issue.
